bot.shortDescription: Drive DeepSeek Harness from Telegram: sessions, shell, files, approvals.
bot.description:
DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.

· Just send text — the Agent answers and streams back live
· /sessions lists sessions, /new creates one, /use binds
· /shell /ls /read /write control the machine directly
· Tool approvals and questions are answered with inline buttons
· /plugins /install manage DSH plugins
· /power /shutdown /reboot for remote power control
help.body:
🤖 DSH Telegram Console

[Sessions]
/sessions list sessions (tap a button to switch)
/new [dir] [| title] create a session with a title
/use <index|session-id|title> switch session (fuzzy titles work)
/info details of the bound session
/cancel cancel the current turn
/fork fork the current session
/rename <title> rename the current session

[Chat]
Send plain text → it becomes a prompt; Agent output streams back
/models list models
/model <provider> <model> pick a model
/presets list Agent presets

[Direct control]
/shell <command> run a command in the session directory
/cd <dir> change directory · /pwd show it
/ls [path] · /read <path> · /write <path>⏎content
/tools list available tools
/tool <name> [JSON] execute a tool directly

[Approvals & questions]
/approvals on|off take over tool approvals
/questions on|off take over ask_user_question
/reasoning on|off forward model reasoning to Telegram (off by default)

[Plugins]
/plugins · /plugin enable|disable <patchId>
/bundles · /install <name|path> · /uninstall <name>

[Host control]
/power host and power status
/shutdown [seconds|now] power off (60s by default)
/reboot [seconds|now] restart
/cancel cancel a turn and abort a scheduled shutdown
/lock lock the screen · /sleep suspend · /hibernate hibernate

[Misc]
/status · /pause · /resume · /myid · /version · /menu · /lang zh|en

💡 Type / to open the command menu (send /menu to re-register it if it is missing)
menu.new: Create and name a session: /new [dir] [| title]
menu.cancel: Cancel the turn and abort a scheduled shutdown
sessions.empty: No sessions yet. Create one with /new [dir | title].
power.deniedHint: Power control is disabled (allowPower=false); enable it on the config page.
power.scheduled:
⏻ {action} scheduled in {seconds}s.
Changed your mind? Send /cancel (or /shutdown cancel) to abort.
power.cancelUnsupported: ⚠️ macOS shutdown has no cancel command — the scheduled {action} will run as planned.
power.confirm:
⚠️ {action} now will interrupt running work. Confirm?
(Use the buttons within 60s, or send /{command} 60 for a countdown)
power.suspendHint: hibernate may be disabled on this system
power.hibernateOn: To enable it: run powercfg /hibernate on as admin
cancel.turn: ⏹ Cancellation requested for the current turn
cancel.nothing: No session is bound and no shutdown is scheduled.
reasoning.on: 🧠 Reasoning will also be sent here (this gets noisy)
reasoning.off: 🧠 Only final answers now; reasoning stays in the Web UI
pause.on: ⏸ Paused: new messages are recorded but ignored. Send /resume to continue.
menu.registered:
✅ Registered {count} commands.
Type / to open the candidate list; if the client has not refreshed yet, switch to another chat and back.
menu.failed: ❌ Command registration failed; see the setMyCommands error in the Host log.
lang.set: 🌐 Language set to {lang}; the command menu was re-registered.
new.title: Title: {title}
new.hint: 💡 To name it: /new dir | title, or /rename <title> afterwards
use.usage:
Usage: /use <index|session-id|title>
· /use 3 or /use #3
· /use login-refactor (title, fuzzy)
· /use 9f3a12 (session id prefix)
Send /sessions to see the list and buttons.
